panels.title: 탐지 미적용 시 예상 비용
panels.description: 실제 지출 비용 + 비용 절감액 (역산). '이 시스템이 없었다면 나갔을 것으로 추정되는 비용'

targets.rawSql:
WITH action_durations AS (
    SELECT
        al.resource_id,
        al.executed_at,
        (elem->>'estimated_saving_usd')::float AS hourly_saving,
        LEAD(al.executed_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY al.resource_id ORDER BY al.executed_at
        ) AS next_action_at
    FROM action_log al
    JOIN agent_runs ar ON al.run_id = ar.run_id
    JOIN agent_steps s ON s.run_id = ar.run_id AND s.step_name = 'decision'
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'candidate_actions') AS elem
    WHERE elem->>'action' = ar.selected_action
      AND al.success = true
      AND $__timeFilter(al.executed_at)
),
total_saving AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
        hourly_saving * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(next_action_at, now()) - executed_at)) / 3600
    ), 0) AS saving
    FROM action_durations
),
actual_cost AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM((s.output->>'latest_cost')::float), 0) AS cost
    FROM agent_steps s
    JOIN agent_runs ar ON ar.run_id = s.run_id
    WHERE s.step_name = 'detection'
      AND s.output->>'latest_cost' IS NOT NULL
      AND $__timeFilter(ar.finished_at)
)
SELECT ROUND((actual_cost.cost + total_saving.saving)::numeric, 2) AS "value"
FROM actual_cost, total_saving;

panels.title: 실제 지출 비용
panels.description: detection 단계에 기록된 latest_cost 합산. 이 코드 수정 이후 새로 쌓이는 데이터부터 값이 나옴

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM((s.output->>'latest_cost')::float)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "value"
FROM agent_steps s
JOIN agent_runs ar ON ar.run_id = s.run_id
WHERE s.step_name = 'detection'
  AND s.output->>'latest_cost' IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ar.finished_at);

panels.title: 비용 절감액
panels.description: 성공한 조치별 시간당 절감액(estimated_saving_usd) × 지속시간(다음 조치 전까지, 없으면 지금까지)의 합

targets.rawSql:
WITH action_durations AS (
    SELECT
        al.resource_id,
        al.executed_at,
        (elem->>'estimated_saving_usd')::float AS hourly_saving,
        LEAD(al.executed_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY al.resource_id ORDER BY al.executed_at
        ) AS next_action_at
    FROM action_log al
    JOIN agent_runs ar ON al.run_id = ar.run_id
    JOIN agent_steps s ON s.run_id = ar.run_id AND s.step_name = 'decision'
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'candidate_actions') AS elem
    WHERE elem->>'action' = ar.selected_action
      AND al.success = true
      AND $__timeFilter(al.executed_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(
        hourly_saving * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(next_action_at, now()) - executed_at)) / 3600
    )::numeric, 2), 0) AS "value"
FROM action_durations;

panels.title: 시나리오별 비용 절감액
panels.description: 최상단 '비용 절감액'과 동일한 방식(시간당 절감액 × 지속시간)을 이상 유형/조치별로 나눠서 집계 — 전부 더하면 최상단 총액과 일치함

targets.rawSql:
WITH action_durations AS (
    SELECT
        al.resource_id,
        ar.anomaly_type,
        al.action_name,
        al.executed_at,
        (elem->>'estimated_saving_usd')::float AS hourly_saving,
        LEAD(al.executed_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY al.resource_id ORDER BY al.executed_at
        ) AS next_action_at
    FROM action_log al
    JOIN agent_runs ar ON al.run_id = ar.run_id
    JOIN agent_steps s ON s.run_id = ar.run_id AND s.step_name = 'decision'
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.output->'candidate_actions') AS elem
    WHERE elem->>'action' = ar.selected_action
      AND al.success = true
      AND $__timeFilter(al.executed_at)
)
SELECT
    (anomaly_type || ' / ' || action_name) AS "시나리오",
    ROUND(SUM(
        hourly_saving * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(next_action_at, now()) - executed_at)) / 3600
    )::numeric, 2) AS "절감액(USD)"
FROM action_durations
GROUP BY anomaly_type, action_name
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM action_log WHERE success = true;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM agent_runs WHERE anomaly_flag = true;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qa_passed = true)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1
    ) AS "value"
FROM agent_runs
WHERE anomaly_flag = true
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_at);

panels.title: 조치 실패로 인한 롤백 건수
panels.description: action_log에는 rolled_back 컬럼이 없어 action_result JSONB에서 꺼내서 집계

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "value" FROM action_log WHERE (action_result->>'rolled_back')::boolean = true;

SELECT
    anomaly_type AS "이상 유형",
    COUNT(*) AS "건수"
FROM agent_runs
WHERE anomaly_flag = true
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)
GROUP BY anomaly_type;

SELECT
    ar.resource_type   AS "리소스",
    ar.resource_id     AS "ID",
    ar.anomaly_type    AS "이상유형",
    al.action_name     AS "액션",
    al.risk_level      AS "위험도",
    al.success         AS "성공",
    al.executed_at     AS "실행시각"
FROM action_log al
JOIN agent_runs ar ON al.run_id = ar.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(al.executed_at)
ORDER BY al.executed_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', finished_at) AS "time",
    COUNT(*) AS "탐지 건수"
FROM agent_runs
WHERE anomaly_flag = true
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', finished_at)
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: 탐지 규칙별 판단 정확도
panels.description: schema/rules/classification_rules.json, qa_rules.json의 규칙별 성능(=예전 'win_rate'). 내부 개발/튜닝용 지표라 메인 스토리(비용 절감)와는 성격이 달라 맨 아래로 분리. rule_stats 테이블이 채워지기 전까지는 빈 패널로 보임 (자기진화 루프 구현 후에 값이 쌓임)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    rule_id      AS "규칙 ID",
    rule_type    AS "타입",
    total_runs   AS "실행 횟수",
    total_wins   AS "성공 횟수",
    ROUND(win_rate::numeric * 100, 1) AS "성공률(%)"
FROM rule_stats
ORDER BY win_rate DESC;
